name: send G4 proxy request
command:
kubectl exec -n liangjiahao prefill-engine-deployment-868546d9f5-g56hb -c prefill-engine -- env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
payload = Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()
response = urlopen(Request(sys.argv[1], payload, {"Content-Type": "application/json"}), timeout=600)
body = response.read()
Path(sys.argv[3]).write_bytes(body)
print(response.status)
assert response.status == 200' http://vllm-proxy-service:8000/v1/completions /tmp/full-validation-20260807T100722Z/g4/request.json /tmp/full-validation-20260807T100722Z/g4/response.json

name: assert G4 contract
command:
python3 -c $'
import json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
summary = json.loads((root / "range-debug-summary.json").read_text())
expected = list(range(27))
assert summary["status"] == "passed" and summary["errors"] == []
assert summary["prefill"] == {"commit_event_count": 1, "event_count": 28, "range_event_count": 27, "range_layers": expected, "whole_key_event_count": 0}
assert summary["decode"] == {"commit_event_count": 0, "event_count": 27, "range_event_count": 27, "range_layers": expected, "whole_key_event_count": 0}
response = json.loads((root / "response.json").read_text())
assert response["choices"][0]["finish_reason"] == "length"
assert response["usage"] == {"prompt_tokens": 525, "completion_tokens": 16, "total_tokens": 541}
for role in ("prefill", "decode"):
    log = (root / f"vllm-{role}.log").read_text()
    assert log.count("POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1\" 200 OK") == 1
    assert "Traceback (most recent call last)" not in log and "TypeError" not in log
    events = [json.loads(line.split("[KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG]", 1)[1].strip()) for line in log.splitlines() if "[KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG]" in line]
    ranges = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "range"]
    assert len(ranges) == 27
    for event in ranges:
        assert event["key_count"] == 4
        assert len(event["sizes"]) == len(event["requested_bytes"]) == len(event["results"]) == 4
        assert all(requested == sum(sizes) == result for requested, sizes, result in zip(event["requested_bytes"], event["sizes"], event["results"]))
prefill_events = [json.loads(line.split("[KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG]", 1)[1].strip()) for line in (root / "vllm-prefill.log").read_text().splitlines() if "[KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG]" in line]
commit_indexes = [index for index, event in enumerate(prefill_events) if event["event"] == "commit"]
assert commit_indexes == [27]
assert prefill_events[27]["layer_id"] == 26 and prefill_events[27]["results"] == [0, 0, 0, 0]
decode_log = (root / "vllm-decode.log").read_text()
assert "kvpool hit tokens: 512, need to load: 512" in decode_log
metrics = (root / "post-request.metrics").read_text()
values = {}
for name in ("master_key_count", "master_allocated_bytes", "master_active_clients", "master_batch_put_start_requests_total", "master_batch_put_end_requests_total"):
    match = re.search(rf"^{name} ([0-9.eE+-]+)$", metrics, re.M)
    assert match
    values[name] = float(match.group(1))
assert values["master_key_count"] == 4 and values["master_allocated_bytes"] > 0
assert values["master_active_clients"] == 2
assert values["master_batch_put_start_requests_total"] == 1
assert values["master_batch_put_end_requests_total"] == 1
print(json.dumps({"validated": True, "num_layers": 27, "prefill_commits": 1, "whole_key_calls": 0, "response_id": response["id"], "metrics": values}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))' /root/ljh/vllm-workspace/features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260807T100722Z/g4
